host_checklist: Obtain an authorized companion repository through connected GitHub.
Freeze the source revision and read the companion guides.

Before creating a usage-conscious-v2 scope or dispatching its actors, verify the authorized companion VERSION is at least 0.11.0 and its supported policies explicitly include usage-conscious-v2. Stop if either check fails; do not silently downgrade to v1.

Before native supervision, verify the authorized companion VERSION is at least 0.12.0; read docs/NATIVE_SUPERVISION.md and retain the authorization spec hash outside checkpoint state. Stop if the gate fails.

Native restore imports historical data only. The host must freshly claim, inspect exact source, audit retained completion evidence, and confirm fetched remote publication before dispatch; metadata cannot install a scheduler or force execution.
Create one usage scope before dispatch.
Reserve and bind each native actor before dispatch, using the returned requested route.
Preserve the same budget scope on retry.
Run the receipt command after code and evidence are complete.
completion_checklist: Reservation and actor binding precede dispatch.
A receipt is required before claiming workflow completion.
Requests to explain or pause do not require agent dispatch.
Coding or other mutating work requires this policy before claiming completion.
native_session_contract.provenance: Routes are requested and locally recorded provenance. Provider model identity is not independently authenticated.
